title: A Tiny GPT in PyTorch
learning_objectives: Assemble token and position embeddings, transformer blocks and an output head into a GPT
Train it on character windows with next-token cross-entropy
Generate text greedily with a context window
entry_point: class TinyGPT(nn.Module); train_tiny_gpt(text, context=16, steps=200, batch_size=32, lr=3e-3, seed=0); generate(model, stoi, itos, prompt, n_new)
hints: In forward: `T = idx.shape[1]`, add `self.pos_emb(torch.arange(T))` to the token embeddings, run the encoder with the mask, then `self.head(self.ln_f(x))`.
Build a batch with `torch.stack([data[i:i + context] for i in ix])` and the targets shifted by one.
Generation loop: crop `ids[-model.context:]`, take `logits[0, -1].argmax()`, append; use `torch.no_grad()`.

failure_feedback.advice: Targets are the inputs shifted by one; use cross-entropy over all positions.
Greedy generation takes argmax of the last position's logits.
Pass the causal mask and is_causal=True to the encoder.
Feed only the last model.context ids when generating.
